correctness.rationale: The complex has as faces exactly edge matchings extendible to a perfect matching after deleting top seam edge T0 from C_n□K2 (n≥3). Every perfect matching using a rung has paired top/bottom horizontal edges, so is an open-ladder matching. For odd n no rungless perfect matching exists and the complex equals L_n≃point. For even n the deleted-top-edge graph has exactly one extra rungless perfect-matching facet F, and its exact simplicial intersection with L_n is Ind(P_{n−1}) via alternating ordered horizontal edges. Open ladder decomposes as a union of two cones with intersection L_{n−2}, so L_{2k}≃S^{k−1}. The attachment inclusion Ind(P_{2k−1})→S^{k−1} is null because the source is contractible or a lower-dimensional sphere (n=4 uses path connectivity), yielding S^{n/2−1}∨Σ Ind(P_{n−1}) and the displayed mod-6 cases. Independently enumerated every perfect matching for n=3..10, confirmed no extra face for odd n and one for even, inspected verify_horizontal_defect.py for reduced mod-two homology tests 3..10 and facet partition 11..14. Finite tests corroborate the analytic all-n decomposition, not prove infinity.
